_PAGE_FILTER_TRUNCATE_MIDDLE_DESCRIPTION: The function filterTruncateMiddle shortens a string in the middle and keeps its start and its end, e.g. for IDs, hashes, IBANs or file paths. Use filterLimitTo to shorten a text at the end.
_PAGE_FILTER_TRUNCATE_MIDDLE_ARGUMENTS_S: The number of characters kept at the start
_PAGE_FILTER_TRUNCATE_MIDDLE_ARGUMENTS_E: The number of characters kept at the end
_PAGE_FILTER_TRUNCATE_MIDDLE_ARGUMENTS_S: The text put in place of the removed characters
